I love this game. Despite the drama behind the studio, the absolute garbage optimization, and the bugs that are actually features, this game was pivotal in Survival open world gaming. I have played so much of the DLC and content, and have messed around in Ascended. I remember being part of 325 server 10 years ago and struggling through no mods and playing with some of the best people I have ever met (and still talk to!). Great memories. Playing now with my kids and I enjoy it- compared to some of the new content, this game still holds up. Yes, you need to tweak the settings, but enjoyment is definitely to be had. It is unfortunate that you have to have a decently powered rig to play (hence why I am not playing ascended with my kids- went back to Evolved) but for building, exploring, and dinos this is top tier. Love Ark. Thanks for all the memories and fun!

Ark was such a flash in the pan. It has some amazing original ideas and an incredibly fun gameplay loop around taking dinos and using them to explore new areas or produce materials to boost your build. But I can't recommend it after the most recent updates. It was a bit of a buggy mess to begin with, but the team was responsive and usually tried to fix things where they could. I don't know anything about the studio being bought and whatnot, but you can tell the care for the players left. 
There are so many good games that can scratch the same itch now. If you like the open world survival and boss fights, valheim is an incredible game. If you like the creatur capture aspect, give palworld a try honestly.
